criteria.information_only: 2025/26 (looked at in earlier development; never used to choose)
criteria.independent_check: 2026/27 so far: production history store (unified_history + markets.parquet), real recorded or archived pre-kick-off prices; evaluated once, after this file's 'strategy' stage is committed
criteria.universe: identical matches for every strategy: matches with real Bet365 opening prices for 1X2 and total 2.5 (Football-Data); ROI = mean profit per unit stake at the real price; refunds and unpriced picks are not bets
criteria.variant_choice: among variants of a family, the highest WORST-fold ROI over 2023/24 and 2024/25 (ties: pooled ROI); a variant with fewer than 300 bets on either fold is not eligible
adoption_rule: 1. ROI higher than strategy A (current Main) on BOTH 2023/24 and 2024/25 on identical matches
2. pooled 2023/24+2024/25 paired bootstrap (resampling matches, 2000 draws): 5th percentile of ROI(strategy) - ROI(A) > 0 (one-sided 95 %)

3. calibration of the shown Main not worse: ECE of the Main picks not higher than A's by more than 0.01 and Brier not higher by more than 0.002 on both folds (a pure betting layer leaves the shown Main unchanged)

4. 2026/27 confirmation within reason: ROI(strategy) - ROI(A) >= 0 on identical 2026/27 matches (point estimate; the 2026/27 sample is too small to require significance) and the strategy's 2026/27 ROI interval reported
5. a positive ROI is claimed only if its 95 % bootstrap interval excludes 0; otherwise reported as 'not distinguishable from 0'

primary.name: G7 EV>0 (meta-model)
primary.definition: Main = A; stake if EV with the inner logistic meta-model probability > 0 (groups seen in training)

secondary.name: B3 selection-conditional
secondary.definition: isotonic map fitted on the inner season's Main picks of A only; rule A on it

secondary.name: C2 value first EV>=0
secondary.definition: rule A, first among priced candidates with EV >= 0

secondary.name: E2 candidate-count penalty
secondary.definition: rule A on p - lambda x log(number of candidates), lambda fitted on the inner season

secondary.name: F1 blend Shin (inner weight)
secondary.definition: rule A on w p + (1 - w) q_Shin(price of the selection's market), w per group by inner log loss

baseline.name: A
baseline.definition: main_prediction() with the production constants (src/config.py MAIN_*, MARKET_RELIABILITY)

chosen.fitting_for_2026_27: every fitted component (calibration maps, blend weights, meta-model, lambda, dropped groups) is fitted on 2025/26 predicted by the models trained on < 2025/26 (walk-forward), bettable universe with Football-Data Bet365 prices; nothing is fitted on 2026/27

universes_2026_27.V1 (primary): production store: latest pre-kick-off version of every 2026/27 match of the unified history; candidates = every selection with a recorded price or, if none, the last OddsPapi archive quote strictly before kick-off; matches with priced 1X2 and total 2.5; q = de-margined price of the same market (Shin) where all its selections are priced
universes_2026_27.V2 (like for like): the same 2026/27 matches and model probabilities, but only the Football-Data markets (1X2, total 2.5, the Asian line) at Football-Data Bet365 opening prices
universes_2026_27.blend weights outside the fitted groups: double chance uses the 1X2 weight; BTTS and corners the totals weight (transforms.BLEND_GROUPS)

chosen.adoption: production changes only if the primary passes rules 1–3 on the folds AND rule 4 on 2026/27 V1

strategy.betting_layer_note: if the primary belongs to family G (the shown Main stays A), adoption means an opt-in stake/skip decision next to the unchanged Main (disabled by default, the interface is outside this study); the Main itself is not changed
